facts.text: Serve the snacks when Meeko goes digging through John Smith's bag for biscuits.
facts.why: The transcript has John Smith handing Meeko a ship's biscuit ('It's a biscuit. It's food. Well, sort of.'), and nothing shows Meeko digging through his bag for biscuits.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when John Smith hands Meeko a ship's biscuit.

facts.text: Child, the corn is roasted and the fish is fresh from the river. Sit down among my roots and eat slowly.
facts.why: Grandmother Willow doesn't say this. It is printed in quote marks. Her real lines include 'Good morning, child. I was hoping you'd visit today.'
facts.fix: Good morning, child. I was hoping you'd visit today.

fix_note.text: Good morning, child. I was hoping you'd visit today.

vibe.verdict: Right characters and a warm look, but the camp words (mess hall, bugle call) don't suit a Powhatan village, and the mains heading sits alone in the wrong column.
missing: Percy the pug in the bath (Governor Ratcliffe's ship)
Grandmother Willow's talk about the spinning arrow
ideas: Swap 'Mess hall mains' and 'Bugle call' for village words such as 'Lodge Table' and 'Corn Call'.
Swap 'Jamestown beef and onion pie' note for Ratcliffe digging for gold.
Add a Percy bath-time tray replacing 'Flit's blueberry mint cooler' note.
Fix the orphaned mains heading in the left column.
